notes: Coverage: 7.1 has only about 26 of the 337 fully-qualified family entries: the yellow kiss/couple/holding-hands/family ZWJ sequences, with no skin tones at all. All the skin-tone couples (E12.0 holding hands, E13.1 kiss/couple-with-heart incl. mixed tones) and 1f9d1_200d_1f91d_200d_1f9d1 people holding hands (E12) fall back to android-12, so most of this subgroup will actually render as android-12. I checked at 512px: android-12 kiss and couple keep 7.1's layout (heart above two faces), and its holding-hands figures are the same Nougat lineage, so the mix holds up. 7.0 and 6.0.1 lack even the gendered kiss/couple variants. If base/tone mismatch on the gendered sequences (e.g. 7.1 woman+man holding hands next to an android-12 toned one) bothers you, set the whole subgroup to android-12 instead. That costs little, because 7.1 and android-12 families look nearly identical. Never let latest win here: its families are keycap tiles.
